verdict.rationale: Inline completions and next-edit suggestions are a fair axis for an AI coding tool with an IDE extension, so the story applies. The evidence only describes agentic task delegation, CLI and cloud workflows, and an IDE install (codex-gh-2), with no mention of as-you-type completions or next-edit prediction. The 'codex completion' command generates shell tab-completions for the CLI, not code suggestions, so it does not count here.
